title: Hom out of an essentially constant pro-system value is the colimit of Hom sets
statement: Let $J$ be a cofiltered category, $\mathcal C$ a category, and $G:J\to\mathcal C$ a diagram that is essentially constant as a pro-object with value $X$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every object $Y$ of $\mathcal C$, the canonical map $\varinjlim_{j\in J}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(G(j),Y)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(X,Y)$ induced by the essential-constancy isomorphisms is a bijection.
